GeneDef.label: life force
GeneDef.description: Wraith tissues store stolen vitality as a visible Life Force reserve. The reserve slowly drains with time, is restored by feeding, and collapses to two percent of normal consumption during deliberate hibernation.
GeneDef.resourceDescription: Stored vitality used by Wraith biology. Feeding restores this reserve; deliberate hibernation greatly reduces its consumption.

GeneDef.label: wraith regeneration
GeneDef.description: Wraith tissue repairs ordinary injuries according to its available Life Force. Fresh feeding accelerates the same biological repair process.

GeneDef.label: wraith feeding organs
GeneDef.description: Specialized Wraith tissues can either fully drain or partially feed from a downed biological pawn.
